seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu
seg.753ec27036d4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud ke Laddoo

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালু হ’ল নাৰিকলৰ লাড়ু, যিটো অন্ধ্ৰৰ ঘৰবোৰত উৎসৱত, নৈবেদ্যত আৰু দৈনন্দিন মিঠাই হিচাপে বনোৱা হয়। লাগে কেৱল নাৰিকল, গুড়, ইলাচি আৰু এচামুচ ঘিঁউ। গুড় গলাই চেকি লোৱা হয়, তাত কম জুইত নাৰিকল ৰন্ধা হয় মিশ্ৰণটো লগ নলগালৈকে, আৰু গৰম থাকোতেই হাতেৰে লাড়ু বান্ধা হয়।
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu is coconut laddoo, which is made in Andhra homes at festivals, in naivedya and as a daily sweet. Needed are only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and one spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, in it the coconut is cooked on low fire until the mixture binds, and while it stays hot the laddoos are shaped by hand.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: আমাৰ চেৰুকু বেল্লামে ইয়াক দিয়ে পাতল সোণালী ৰং আৰু কোমল কেৰামেলৰ দৰে সোৱাদ। এই ৰেচিপিত প্ৰায় 14টা লাড়ু হয়।
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our Cheruku Bellam gives it a light golden colour and a soft caramel-like taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddoos.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: লাড়ুবোৰ ৰখাৰ আগতে চেঁচা হ’বলৈ আৰু 15 মিনিট সময় দিয়ক।
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Before keeping the laddoos, give 15 more minutes for them to become cool.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় গলাই খুৰুচা নাৰিকলৰ লগত ৰান্ধক যেতিয়ালৈকে লগ নলগে, ইলাচি আৰু ঘিঁউ মিহলাই লাড়ু বান্ধক।
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery and cook with scraped coconut until it binds, mix cardamom and ghee and shape laddoos.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 কাপ খুৰুচা নাৰিকল ⟦1⟧1টা মাজাৰি নাৰিকল; কেৱল বগা অংশ খুৰুচক⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups scraped coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; scrape only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 কাপ খুৰুচা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় ⟦1⟧প্ৰায় 180 g; আগতে টুকুৰাবোৰ থেকেচি বা খুৰুচি লওক⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup scraped sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first crush or scrape the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 ডাঙৰ চামুচ ঘিঁউ ⟦1⟧আৰু হাতৰ তলুৱাত সানিবলৈ অলপ⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 big spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little for smearing on the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10টা কাজু, ঐচ্ছিক ⟦1⟧ভাঙি ঘিঁউত সোণালী কৰি ভজা⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: নাৰিকল খুৰুচি লওক, মটিয়া ছালখিনি এৰি দিয়ক, তেতিয়া লাড়ুৰ ৰং পাতল থাকিব।
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Scrape the coconut, leave out the brown skin, then the colour of the laddoo will stay light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড় থেকেচি বা খুৰুচি সৰু সৰু টুকুৰা কৰক, যাতে সমানকৈ গলে।
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Crush or scrape the sugarcane jaggery into small small pieces, so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: কম জুইত 2 ডাঙৰ চামুচ পানীৰে গুড় গলাই লওক, তাৰ পিছত মিহি চেকনিৰে চেকি লওক। ইয়াত গুড়ৰ খণ্ডৰ পৰা অহা সৰু সৰু কণা বা কুঁহিয়াৰৰ টুকুৰা আটকি থাকে।
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low heat, then strain it with a fine strainer. In this, the small small particles or pieces of sugarcane that come from the jaggery lump get stuck.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: পুনৰ কেৰাহীত ঢালি নাৰিকল দিয়ক আৰু মাজাৰি-কম জুইত লৰাই লৰাই ৰান্ধক, যেতিয়ালৈকে মিশ্ৰণটো কেৰাহীৰ কাষ এৰি দিয়ে আৰু লগ লাগে, 12–15 মিনিট। লৰাই থাকক, যাতে তলত লাগি নাযায়।
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Pour again into the kadai, add the coconut and cook stirring stirring on medium-low fire, until the mixture leaves the sides of the kadai and binds, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring, so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: কাজু দিলে মিশ্ৰণ ৰন্ধাৰ সময়তে অলপ ঘিঁউত সোণালী নোহোৱালৈকে ভাজি লওক।
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If adding cashews, at the time of cooking the mixture fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: ইলাচি, ঘিঁউ আৰু কাজু মিহলাই দিয়ক। কেৰাহীখন জুইৰ পৰা নমাই লওক।
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the kadai down from the fire.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: হাতেৰে ধৰিব পৰা হোৱালৈকে চেঁচা হ’ব দিয়ক, হাতৰ তলুৱাত ঘিঁউ সানি সৰু সৰু গোল বান্ধক। প্ৰতিটো টানকৈ হেঁচি লওক, যাতে লগ লাগি থাকে।
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: Let it cool until it can be held with the hand, smear ghee on the palms and shape small small balls. Press each one firmly, so that it stays bound.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: লাড়ুবোৰ ঘিঁউ সনা থালত ৰাখক আৰু ৰখাৰ আগতে সম্পূৰ্ণ চেঁচা হ’বলৈ দিয়ক।
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Keep the laddoos on a ghee-smeared plate and before storing let them become completely cool.

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: মিশ্ৰণে আকাৰ নধৰিলে আৰু 2 মিনিট ৰান্ধক। বেছি টান হৈ গ’লে এচামুচ গৰম গাখীৰ ছটিয়াই আকৌ হেঁচি লওক।
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the mixture does not take shape cook 2 more minutes. If it becomes too hard sprinkle one spoon of hot milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: জুই মাজাৰি-কমত ৰাখক; বেছি জুইত গুড় ক’লা পৰি যায় আৰু লাড়ু টান হয়।
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the fire at medium-low; on high fire the jaggery turns black and the laddoo becomes hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: মিশ্ৰণ গৰম থাকোতেই লাড়ু বান্ধক; সম্পূৰ্ণ চেঁচা হৈ গ’লে আৰু লগ নলগে।
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Shape the laddoos while the mixture is hot; once completely cool it will not bind any more.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: তালৰ গুড়: একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় লওক, লাড়ু ক’লা হ’ব আৰু মিঠাত অলপ ধোঁৱাযুক্ত সোৱাদ থাকিব।
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: take the same amount of scraped palm jaggery, the laddoos will be black and in the sweetness there will be a slightly smoky taste.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: শুকান নাৰিকল: একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা শুকান নাৰিকল (কোপ্ৰা) লওক; মিশ্ৰণ সোনকালে লগ লাগে, গতিকে চকু ৰাখক।
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: take the same amount of scraped dry coconut (kopra); the mixture binds quickly, so keep an eye.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: কোব্বাৰি বৰফি: ৰন্ধা মিশ্ৰণ ঘিঁউ সনা থালত বিলাই অলপ জমিব দিয়ক, লাড়ু নবান্ধি চৌকোণীয়াকৈ কাটি লওক।
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari Barfi: spread the cooked mixture on a ghee-smeared plate and let it set a little, without shaping laddoos cut it into squares.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: দৈনন্দিন মিঠাই হিচাপে পৰিবেশন কৰক, নৈবেদ্য হিচাপে দিয়ক, বা উৎসৱৰ মিঠাইৰ থালত ৰাখক।
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve as a daily sweet, give as naivedya, or keep on a festival sweets plate.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: বতাহ নোসোমোৱা পাত্ৰত ৰাখক; কোঠাৰ উষ্ণতাত 3 দিনৰ ভিতৰত খাওক, বা ফ্ৰিজত ৰাখিলে এসপ্তাহৰ ভিতৰত।
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an air-tight container; eat within 3 days at room temperature, or if kept in the fridge within one week.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: মোৰ কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালুৱে আকাৰ ধৰি ৰাখিব পৰা নাই কিয়?
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why is my Kobbari Undalu not able to hold shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: মিশ্ৰণটো আৰু অলপ ৰান্ধিব লাগিব। পুনৰ কম জুইত 2 মিনিট লৰাই লৰাই ৰান্ধক, যেতিয়ালৈকে কেৰাহীৰ কাষ এৰি দিয়ে, তাৰ পিছত গৰম থাকোতেই বান্ধক।
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The mixture needs to be cooked a little more. Again on low fire cook 2 minutes stirring stirring, until it leaves the sides of the kadai, after that shape while it is hot.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.t: মোৰ লাড়ু টান হৈ গ’ল কিয়?
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddoos become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: গুড় বেছি সময় বা বেছি জুইত ৰন্ধা হৈছিল। এচামুচ গৰম গাখীৰ ছটিয়াই মিহলাই আকৌ হেঁচি লওক। পিছবাৰ মিশ্ৰণ লগ লগাৰ লগে লগে কেৰাহীখন জুইৰ পৰা নমাওক।
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery was cooked too much time or on too high fire. Sprinkle one spoon of hot milk, mix and press again. Next time as soon as the mixture binds take the kadai down from the fire.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: তালৰ গুড়েৰে কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালু বনাব পাৰি নে?
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can Kobbari Undalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.813bf680c8a8.t: পাৰি। একে পৰিমাণৰ খুৰুচা তালৰ গুড় (তাটি বেল্লাম) লওক। লাড়ু ক’লা হ’ব, আৰু মিঠাত অলপ ধোঁৱাযুক্ত সোৱাদ থাকিব।
seg.813bf680c8a8.back: It can. Take the same amount of scraped palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddoos will be black, and in the sweetness there will be a slightly smoky taste.

seg.ea6121eb3993.src: How long do kobbari undalu keep?
seg.ea6121eb3993.t: কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালু কিমান দিন ৰাখিব পাৰি?
seg.ea6121eb3993.back: How many days can Kobbari Undalu be kept?

seg.26aba27412dc.src: About 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature, and up to a week in the fridge.
seg.26aba27412dc.t: বতাহ নোসোমোৱা পাত্ৰত কোঠাৰ উষ্ণতাত প্ৰায় 3 দিন, আৰু ফ্ৰিজত এসপ্তাহলৈকে।
seg.26aba27412dc.back: In an air-tight container at room temperature about 3 days, and in the fridge up to one week.

seg.0156a887ba6f.src: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra kobbari undalu: grated coconut cooked with Cheruku Bellam cane jaggery, cardamom and ghee, then rolled into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.0156a887ba6f.t: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. অন্ধ্ৰৰ কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালু: খুৰুচা নাৰিকল চেৰুকু বেল্লাম কুঁহিয়াৰৰ গুড়, ইলাচি আৰু ঘিঁউৰে ৰান্ধি লাড়ু বান্ধা। পদক্ষেপ অনুসৰি পদ্ধতি, টিপচ আৰু প্ৰশ্নোত্তৰ।
seg.0156a887ba6f.back: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra's Kobbari Undalu: scraped coconut cooked with Cheruku Bellam sugarcane jaggery, cardamom and ghee and shaped into laddoos. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.fc0444bcc4df.src: Kobbari Undalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.fc0444bcc4df.t: কোব্বাৰি উণ্ডালু: 1acrefarms-ৰ ৰেচিপি কাৰ্ড, উপাদান আৰু পদ্ধতিসহ
seg.fc0444bcc4df.back: Kobbari Undalu: 1acrefarms' recipe card, with ingredients and method
